problem_statement: A mapped MTD region should not have to duplicate the physical properties of the backing MTD device. A region definition may omit those properties and give only its sector count, parent device, and offset; after initialization it must still be usable as an MTD device and must have physical properties consistent with the backing device.

verification.reason: The problem statement clearly describes that a mapped MTD region may omit physical properties (page_size, pages_per_sector, write_size) and only provide sector count, parent device, and offset, and must still have consistent physical properties after initialization. The hidden test simply removes those fields from the region definitions and expects the test to still pass, which is exactly what the statement asks for. No new names, exact values, or implementation details are required beyond what the statement and repository provide.
